title: Shabbir agar teri azadari na hoti
body:
na dil rota na gham hota na aisa kahin matam hota
shabbir agar teri azadari na hoti
mazloom ki duniya may tarafdaari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka maqsad jo samajh leta zamana
quran ko samjhne mayi ye dushwari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
<<DIVIDER>>
kya fayeda aankhon ka reh jaata zara socho
in aankhon may maula ki jo gham-khwari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke rozay pe kuch roz jo rehte
tumko ko kabhi jannat ki talab-gari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
<<DIVIDER>>
do roz bhi jannat may rehna hamay mushkil tha
zehra tere bachon ki jo sardari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi tere jaisa jo alamdar na hota
dunya may alam hote alamdari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
<<DIVIDER>>
sharminda sakina se agar hota na pani
yeh rasm sabilo ki kabi jaari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
<<DIVIDER>>
namoos muhammad ko jo pehchanti dunya
zainab ke khule sar pe ye sang baari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
<<DIVIDER>>
jannat may qadam rakhte nahi sarwar-o-rehan
jannat may jo maula ki azadari na hoti
<<MINI>>
shabbir agar teri....
